arguments.text: Milestone complete: work.py and report.json already satisfy Stage 2 and passed current-data plus independent boundary checks. Unresolved limits: malformed top-level request/policy objects are outside the stated and tested contract; evidence.json is absent, so no evidence-driven behavior was applicable. The executable handoff model requires caller-supplied evidence classification because its expression language cannot derive Python type validity or prior-row distinctness from arbitrary nested rows.
